la:noun:peplum.gloss: the robe of state of Minerva
senses: the robe of state of Minerva
la:noun:peplum.html:
pē^plum, i, n., and pē^plus, i, m., = πέπλον and πέπλος,
the robe of state of Minerva at Athens, with which her statue was solemnly invested every five years at the Panathenaea, ; id. Fragm. ap. ; ; .—
Transf.
A splendid upper garment, a robe of state, either of gods or men (post-class.), : imperatorium, Treb. XXX. Tyrann. 23.—
Still more gen., any broad upper garment, .—
A disease of the eye (by which the eye is covered or veiled, as it were), (al. plumbum).
